convert_prompt_depth_checkpoint: convert a Prompt Depth Anything checkpoint from the original repository to HuggingFace format
get_dpt_config: get the DPT configuration for a Prompt Depth Anything model by name (small, base, or large)
transform_qkv_weights: transform combined qkv weight tensors into separate query, key, and value weight tensors
convert_old_keys_to_new_keys: convert old state dict keys to new HuggingFace-style keys using regex mappings
verify_model_conversion: verify the converted model produces expected depth predictions with sample images
